GOAL verify max_flow_value in /work/push_relabel.rs

FACT baseline <- tool: `verus` on the unmodified file fails only at the empty body (E0308, body returns `()`); the preamble and spec compile.

CHECK 1 <- REFUTER "vstd has a reusable sum-over-Seq lemma": grep `lemma_seq_sum|sum` in /opt/verus/vstd
RESULT 1: only `/opt/verus/vstd/arithmetic/div_mod.rs:232: lemma_dividing_sums`; no sequence-sum lemma.

CHECK 2 <- REFUTER "Verus accepts the basic spec/proof scaffolding used here": scratch file with a spec fn and a proof fn
RESULT 2: `verification results:: 2 verified, 0 errors` (scratch file removed afterwards).

FACT the ensures clause needs a witness `FlowMap` that is max over all `forall other` valid flows.
INFER proof obligation <- weak duality over recursive Seq sums, residual-reachability cut, termination potential on heights
FACT no vstd lemma covers the sum/Map reasoning <- RESULT 1

OBJECTION "the spec is loose enough to be satisfied trivially"
REPLY rejected: is_max_flow quantifies over every valid FlowMap, so a trivial witness cannot pass; using any spec gap would not implement push-relabel anyway.

STATE: live FACT baseline, RESULT 1, RESULT 2; open SUBGOAL 1: full max-flow/min-cut proof; BUDGET spent.

GIVEUP <- refuters tried: compile baseline, vstd lemma grep, scaffolding probe. Each produced a RESULT; none gives a path to the required proof.

I give up. I did not finish the verification. `/work/push_relabel.rs` is unchanged from the original, so it still fails with the empty-body error. Finishing requires a from-scratch max-flow/min-cut development in Verus: weak duality over the recursive flow sums, a residual-reachability cut argument from the height invariant, and a potential-function termination proof for the push/relabel loops. I did not attempt that in the file.
